comments.text: The headaches started when I was 13 blinding stabbing pain that would bring me to my knees. I ignored it. Then the blackouts started. I ignored it. By the age of 15 I couldn’t ignore the floaters. My vision was getting worse by degrees. I still found an afterschool job working at the county hospital answering phones in the psychiatric ward. I ran seven blocks and finally the bus caught up with me. I did not go back to that department. The following year, my eyesight was so much worse, but I was faking it. Bluffing as much as I could. I got a job in the same county hospital this time working in the radiology department in the file room. Hated it. General Hospital made working in a hospital.
